title: Surviving Economic Adversity: Governance of Franchise Clusters
authors: Xu (Vivian) Zheng, Yajing Fan, Mrinal Ghosh

package_source.dataset_title: Replication Data for: Surviving Economic Adversity: Governance of Franchise Clusters

eligible_reason: Survival analysis of franchised outlet failure (8,677 outlets, 18 franchisors, 2009-2023) with governance moderators; README maps Tables 3-6 and D/E tables to analysis/modeling.do (descriptives, a first-stage regression, hazard models m1-m11). No DiD.
design_notes: Only Readme.pdf is public; the package zip is restricted and was not requested. FDD outlet data (purchased from FRANdata) are not provided even in the package ('Franchise Disclosure Files ... Provided FALSE'); BEA/Census county files are provided.
data_access: partial (licensed FDD data not provided; package zip restricted)
screener_notes: Ruled out from abstract and README.
main_text_note: Article confirms survival (hazard) models of outlet failure with instrumented governance variables (first-stage regressions); no DiD terms.
